assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing turns a defined nucleobase deamination chemistry (cytidine and engineered adenosine deaminases fused to a Cas9 nickase) into a general tool for single-nucleotide change without double-strand breaks. It gives biologists a precise chemical handle on the genome and has direct therapeutic reach, which matches what I value most: a biological process rendered as a well-defined chemical reaction.
assessment.attribution: Liu's laboratory conceived and led the programme; Komor developed the cytosine base editor and Gaudelli the adenine base editor as the decisive first-author contributions. Other credited names (Kondo, Nishida) worked on related deaminase-CRISPR fusions, but the Liu/Komor/Gaudelli trio is the clearest chemical-invention core. Whether a prize would go to Liu alone or with the trainees is a judgement call.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced in many labs and organisms, with clinical trials under way and the editors now standard reagents. Timing looks ripe, although some committee members may prefer waiting for clinical outcomes.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2020 CRISPR prize and with the prime-editing candidate may make the committee reluctant to recognise genome-editing chemistry again.
Long-term off-target deamination, including RNA and bystander edits, remains an active question.
My recollection of the Kondo and Nishida Target-AID priority claim is from memory, not verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced proximity through bifunctional degraders and molecular glues reframes drug action as event-driven chemistry that hijacks ubiquitin ligases to destroy targets previously considered undruggable. It is a new pharmacological concept with a mechanism that can be measured, and it has strong medical relevance.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated the first PROTACs; Ciulli made the structure-based VHL ligands and degrader design principles that made the approach general. Handa, Ito and others established the thalidomide cereblon glue mechanism, which is a distinct sub-discovery. Credit is split between PROTACs and glues, so a fair three-person configuration is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Many clinical-stage degraders, with the first Phase 3 programmes progressing, and strong independent reproduction. Clinical proof of approval is still maturing, which makes it slightly early.
uncertainties: PROTAC and molecular-glue credit are separable and may need different recognition.
No approved PROTAC drug yet as far as I know.
Priority attribution of the early peptide-based PROTAC is something I recall but cannot verify.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing, especially sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminators, transformed biology and medicine and rests on nucleotide chemistry: modified nucleotides, polymerase incorporation and clonal amplification. Its impact on genomics is hard to overstate, and I know well how central nucleotide chemistry is to it.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman invented the Solexa sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry; Mayer co-developed the clustering and colony amplification concept. Rothberg's pyrosequencing-bead platform and Ju's work on terminators are credible alternatives, so credit is contested and the platform history is entangled between companies.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature, with decades of independent use. Recognition is more than timely, and the question is only who is credited.
uncertainties: Attribution dispute among Solexa, 454 and other chemistries, including the role of Ju's reversible terminators.
The committee may judge it closer to biology or physiology than chemistry, although I regard the chemistry as central.
I have not independently verified the priority of the colony amplification idea.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the delivery chemistry that made siRNA and mRNA medicines work, including the COVID-19 vaccines. The key insight, pH-dependent ionisation of the lipid for encapsulation and endosomal escape, is a clear chemical principle with enormous demonstrated impact.
assessment.attribution: Cullis led the development of ionizable lipid formulation and rapid mixing; Anderson and Langer contributed combinatorial lipidoid libraries. MacLachlan, Hope and Madden were also central in the Vancouver work. Credit is spread over a larger group than three, and some of the decisive lipid chemistry was done in industry.
assessment.maturity: Validated by billions of vaccine doses and approved siRNA drugs. Recognition would be timely, and the 2023 Medicine prize on nucleoside modification touched the same field.
uncertainties: Attribution between academic and industrial groups, and between early Vancouver work and later lipid design, is uncertain.
The 2023 Medicine prize may already have been seen as covering this area.
My view of the relative priority of the lipid structures is from memory, not verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Covalent targeting of the KRAS G12C mutant, along with analogue-sensitive kinase chemical genetics, showed that a long-standing undruggable oncogene can be reached by selective chemistry. The discovery of the switch-II pocket and the resulting drugs are a concrete example of chemistry opening a biological target.
assessment.attribution: Attribution is clear and singular: the Shokat laboratory discovered the allosteric cysteine-targeting approach and the chemical-genetic kinase tools. Industry teams developed sotorasib and adagrasib, but these followed from his work.
assessment.maturity: Approved drugs and extensive independent validation make the KRAS part mature. Chemical genetics is older and also well established.
uncertainties: Two themes (KRAS covalent drugging and chemical genetics) may be seen as a compound discovery.
Resistance and modest response durability in patients could temper enthusiasm, though not the chemistry.
Industry priority for the clinical compounds is not something I can verify.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible RNA methylation introduced an epitranscriptomic layer of regulation in which writers, erasers and readers act on m6A. This links defined chemical modification to gene expression, development and disease, and it is a mechanistic discovery in nucleic acid chemistry that I find compelling.
assessment.attribution: He identified FTO as an m6A demethylase and proposed the reversible-modification framework; Jaffrey and Rechavi mapped m6A transcriptome-wide in 2012. Others (Jia, Dominissini, Meyer, Yang) were co-authors, and writer and reader discoveries involve additional laboratories, so the configuration is arguable.
assessment.maturity: Intense independent activity, though some mapping results and mechanistic details of readers and the physiological role of FTO substrates remain debated. As a measurement-first scientist I would want quantification issues in m6A mapping settled.
uncertainties: Antibody-based mapping artefacts and stoichiometry questions have been raised.
Credit among mapping, demethylase and reader discoveries is unresolved.
The disease relevance of specific m6A marks is not yet fully established.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing reads single DNA or RNA molecules by ionic current, linking engineered protein pores with enzyme-controlled translocation to direct sequencing. It is an inventive single-molecule analytical method with real utility, including direct RNA and modification detection.
assessment.attribution: Bayley developed engineered pores and single-molecule stochastic sensing; Akeson, Branton and Deamer demonstrated polynucleotide detection and enzyme-controlled movement. Kasianowicz is also credited with the first polymer translocation measurements. This is a contested field with multiple claims over priority.
assessment.maturity: Commercially deployed and independently validated, but accuracy for some applications is still improving.
uncertainties: Priority disputes among the early pore groups.
Whether chemistry or physics is the best home for the prize.
Fine details of who first showed enzyme-ratcheted reading are not something I can verify.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion lets cells incorporate unnatural amino acids by orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs, which gives chemists site-specific control over protein chemistry in living cells. It is a general tool for biologists and a conceptual change in how proteins are engineered.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang established the first orthogonal translation systems in vivo; Chin extended to quadruplet codons, multiple codes and genomically recoded organisms. Mehl and Yokoyama contributed important systems. The three-person selection is a reasonable one but not unique.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted, with many independent users, though few large-scale applications beyond research tools and some biologics.
uncertainties: Overlap with the earlier directed-evolution and chemical biology recognition.
Limited therapeutic translation to date.
Exact credit for the first orthogonal pair is from memory.
